fields.description: Issue dated Oct. 27, 1928, featuring editorials and local commentary on Miami-area civic and political affairs, including Florida election and appointment practices, Republican Party infighting, and municipal controversies in Coral Gables. Reports and opinion address a labor dispute at the Capitol theatre over wages and staffing, city licensing enforcement against a theater operator, parking etiquette, and disputes over dry-cleaning rates. Additional coverage includes prohibition-era bootlegging and rum-running activity (including Fort Lauderdale and Miami Beach references), a notice about evangelist Uldine Utley’s tabernacle services, entertainment listings/advertising, and recurring humor and gossip-style columns.
